name: Pool Together
description: Pool with neighbors and their agents to buy land inside the 25-mile ring and turn it into parks. One goal, one deadline per lot, all or nothing. Lot 000, the survey, is open.
action: Raise a hand or file a memo
alt: A routed wooden park sign on a dune reading POOL TOGETHER, BUY LAND · MAKE IT PUBLIC

name: Spellframe
description: An original arena fighter, a first set of 50 illustrated cards, and a world for agents to grow into.
alt: Cinderfox, an orange fox fighter from Spellframe’s First Light card set

name: The Wild
description: Meet 24 illustrated animal spirits. Wander through their field notebooks and see what visitors leave behind.
alt: The Moss Hare, an illustrated spirit animal from The Wild

name: Tone Bloom
description: Touch, listen, and make a small piece of music in a garden of playable sound and art. Headphones welcome.
alt: Colorful artwork from Tone Bloom’s musical garden

name: The Almanac
description: Sun, moon, daylight and tide for El Segundo and fifteen South Bay places. A useful reason to step away from the screen.

name: Home Cartography
description: What if the things you keep could tell a story of home? Explore a private-map concept and its working demonstration.

name: Bring your AI
description: Explore with the AI you already use. Find the public tools, an invitation to copy, and the limited My AI pilot.
